newsitem.title: UK: Bradford & Bingley raises mortgage rates.
newsitem.headline: Bradford & Bingley raises mortgage rates.

text.p: Bradford & Bingley, Britain's fifth largest building society, said on Thursday it will raise its variable base mortgage rate by 0.25 percent to 6.99 percent as of December 15.
The building society said it will also increase the interest rate on its variable direct mortgage by 0.25 percent to 6.24 percent.
Bradford & Bingley is also increasing savings rates by between 0.1 and 0.45 percentage points.
A number of major lenders, led by Abbey National Plc, have raised their mortgage rates in the past month.
